title: Document the standard front end on the Papyrus marketing site
description: Standing rule (Ryan): every feature epic ends with documenting the feature on the Papyrus marketing site (p.apyr.us product site). Cover: one standard front end for static sites (projection.json, theme, hooks), RSS and Atom feeds, sitemap/robots/SEO, listings and archives, forms component, logo-wall showcase. Related: PPY-b9b038 (features list kept current).

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live 2026-10-21: https://p.apyr.us/standard-front-end.html documents the standard front end (projection.json, theme, hooks, feeds RSS/Atom, sitemap/robots/SEO, listings, forms, the Built-with wall, page blocks, islands, family footer, clean URLs, and the 5.12.0 options). Papyrus-web PRs #15, #20, #22 (Amplify jobs 14, 18, 20 SUCCEED, papyrus-production 712236451410); page returns 200 text/html, its .md twin 200 text/markdown, Accept: text/markdown returns markdown, and it is listed in llms.txt and sitemap.xml. Claims were limited to behaviour described in docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md and confirmed by curl on the sites named.
